title: The only slip covers I’ve ever liked
text:
The only slip covers I’ve ever liked. Slip covers that I tried in the past were returned. Others looked cheap and made my chairs look like giant marshmallows. (Not the look I wanted. 😊) Thankfully, these are different!
These slip covers have a seam that matches the outer edge of the outer edge of my chairs. The seam gives these slip covers a custom fit look.
They are a bit of a struggle to put on to get the seams straight, but well worth it.
